---
title: "Elapsed time (log₁₀ years) × Disturbance"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(here::here("chapters", "Rscripts", "14_epred_cache.R"))
cache_dir <- here::here("Rdata", "epred_draws")
cache     <- read_epred_cache("m12", cache_dir)
```

Interaction: does the rate of divergence over time depend on the type of disturbance? Prediction ribbons are faceted by disturbance.

## Model summary

`summary()` is read from the pre-computed cache (`outputs/epred_draws/m12.rds`) — the full `brms` fit is never loaded at render.

```{r summary}
print_cache_summary(cache)
```

## Posterior predictions

The location panel shows predicted mean lnM; the scale panel shows predicted residual sigma. Draws were pre-computed once with `re_formula = NA`; restyle the figure by editing the plot helpers in `R/14_epred_cache.R` — no epreds re-run.

```{r figure, fig.width=9, fig.height=11}
plot_cache(cache)
```
